title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉省 Cabagan市镇 Tallag 村学校的名称变更为Biuag 社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Tallag Barrio School in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela, to Biuag Community School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Tallag Barrio School in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela, to Biuag Community School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Tallag Barrio School tại Thị trấn Cabagan, Tỉnh Isabela thành Biuag Community School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Tallag Barrio School ในเทศบาล Cabagan, จังหวัด Isabela เป็น Biuag Community School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Tallag Barrio School di Kotamadya Cabagan, Provinsi Isabela menjadi Biuag Community School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Tallag Barrio School di Perbandaran Cabagan, Wilayah Isabela menjadi Biuag Community School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2126_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Tallag Barrio School in the Municipality of Cabagan, Province of Isabela, is hereby changed to Biuag Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 7, 1959.
